svg.text: 1. One net label / colour = one electrical node. The same name at both ends means wired together.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Signal names are printed along the routing rails; the schedule on the right is the authoritative pin list.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. GND is a star: every return meets at pin 39. Never daisy-chain sensor grounds.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Never apply 5 V to a sensor pin. Power the Pi from the official 5 V / 3 A supply only.
